summary: Q3 FY2026 report (April 30, 2026) was the major catalyst: revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY), beat guidance by $1.15B, non-GAAP EPS $23.41 vs $12-14 guidance. $6B buyback authorization. Near-term catalysts: AI datacenter NAND demand, QLC Stargate SSD shipping for revenue this fiscal Q4, $42B multi-year contract backlog provides earnings visibility. Next earnings report estimated August 13, 2026.
